description: Header file defining functions for configuration and environment variable iteration, event emission, and memory cleanup related to trace configuration.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_list_config_fl
methods.description: Iterates over configuration settings and emits 'def_param' events for interesting ones.

methods.name: tr2_list_env_vars_fl
methods.description: Iterates over environment variables and emits 'def_param' events for interesting ones.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_set_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'def_param' event for a given key/value pair if considered interesting.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_patterns
methods.description: Frees resources associated with configuration patterns.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_env_vars
methods.description: Frees resources associated with environment variables.
